nodes.description: mapping(address => uint256) private _balances; token balances of every holder, read/written by transfer paths
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) private _allowances; ERC20 allowances updated by approve/transferFrom
mapping(address => bool) public _blacklist; blacklisted senders are blocked during sells
mapping(address => uint256) private _sellLock; per address timestamp until which selling is blocked
uint256 public sellLockTime; duration added to block.timestamp when locking a seller
uint256 public marketingBalance; BNB claimable by team and drained by TeamWithdrawMarketingBNB
private _transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount); central router that dispatches to feeless, whitelist or taxed transfer logic
private _taxedTransfer(...); applies buy/sell/transfer taxes, sell lock, limits and triggers contract token swap
private _feelessTransfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount); tax free balance movement
private _swapContractToken(uint256 totalMax) lockTheSwap; swaps accumulated contract tokens for BNB, adds liquidity and distributes fees
private _swapTokenForBNB(uint256 amount); approves and swaps tokens to ETH through the Pancake router
private _addLiquidity(uint256 tokenamount, uint256 bnbamount); adds liquidity with the collected BNB
public onlyTeam TeamWithdrawMarketingBNB(); zeroes marketingBalance and sends it with a low level call to the team wallet
public onlyTeam TeamAvoidBurning(); sends the whole contract balance with a raw call to msg.sender
public AddressResetSellLock(); any caller resets its own sell lock to block.timestamp + sellLockTime
public onlyTeam TeamRescueTokens(address tknAddress); transfers arbitrary tokens held by the contract to the caller
external transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount); public ERC20 entry point calling _transfer with msg.sender
external transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount); public ERC20 entry point calling _transfer and decreasing allowance
public onlyTeam TeamSetSellLockTime(uint256 sellLockSeconds); updates sellLockTime bounded by MaxSellLockTime
msg.sender; externally controlled caller used for ownership checks, sell lock keys, token and BNB payouts
block.timestamp; miner influenced time used for sell locks and router deadlines
low level call in TeamWithdrawMarketingBNB: TeamWallet.call{value: amount}("") with success require
low level call in TeamAvoidBurning: msg.sender.call{value: address(this).balance}("") forwarding all balance to the caller
external call to _pancakeRouter.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with deadline block.timestamp
external payable call to _pancakeRouter.addLiquidityETH{value: bnbamount} with deadline block.timestamp
external IBEP20 token.transfer(msg.sender, ourBalance) on an arbitrary user supplied token address
sender parameter of _transfer/_taxedTransfer/_feelessTransfer/transferFrom
recipient parameter of the transfer family of functions
amount parameter of the transfer family of functions
isBuy flag derived from sender being pair or router
isSell flag derived from recipient being pair or router
tknAddress parameter of TeamRescueTokens selecting the token to drain
sellLockSeconds parameter of TeamSetSellLockTime
local uint8 tax selected per transfer type inside _taxedTransfer
local uint256 contractToken holding the fee amount computed by _calculateFee inside _taxedTransfer
local uint256 taxedAmount = amount - contractToken inside _taxedTransfer
local uint256 senderBalance read from _balances[sender] inside _taxedTransfer

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the sender argument of transfer and flows into the token transfer path
block.timestamp is compared with _sellLock[sender] and sets the new lock, a timestamp dependency
AddressResetSellLock stores block.timestamp + sellLockTime for msg.sender, a timestamp dependency
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline to the router, a timestamp dependency
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline, a timestamp dependency
msg.sender is the key written into the _sellLock mapping
msg.sender is the recipient of the full contract balance via a raw call in TeamAvoidBurning
msg.sender receives the rescued token balance in TeamRescueTokens
_transfer branches into _taxedTransfer for normal taxed transfers
_transfer branches into _feelessTransfer for excluded/contract/liquidity transfers
_taxedTransfer conditionally calls _swapContractToken when auto conversion is on
_swapContractToken calls _swapTokenForBNB to swap tokens for BNB
_swapContractToken calls _addLiquidity with the generated BNB
TeamWithdrawMarketingBNB performs a low level value call to the team wallet before state is fully settled
TeamAvoidBurning performs a low level value call sending the entire balance to msg.sender
_swapTokenForBNB invokes the external Pancake router swap function
_addLiquidity invokes the external Pancake router addLiquidityETH function
TeamRescueTokens invokes an external transfer on a user supplied token contract
public transfer delegates to the internal _transfer function
public transferFrom delegates to the internal _transfer function
_taxedTransfer reads and updates _balances for sender and recipient
_feelessTransfer reads and updates _balances for sender and recipient
sellLockTime is added to block.timestamp when locking a seller in _taxedTransfer
sellLockTime is added to block.timestamp in AddressResetSellLock
marketingBalance is read, zeroed and paid out in TeamWithdrawMarketingBNB
_sellLock mapping is read and written during sell and transfer checks
TeamSetSellLockTime writes the sellLockTime state variable
_blacklist mapping is checked for the sender during sells
sender parameter is consumed by the taxed transfer logic
recipient parameter is consumed by the taxed transfer logic
amount parameter is consumed by the taxed transfer logic
isBuy parameter selects the buy tax and whale checks
isSell parameter selects the sell tax, lock and dump protection
tknAddress parameter determines which token contract is drained
sellLockSeconds parameter is validated and stored into sellLockTime
local tax variable holds the selected tax rate inside _taxedTransfer
local contractToken holds the computed fee inside _taxedTransfer
local taxedAmount holds the post fee amount credited to the recipient
local senderBalance caches _balances[sender] for the balance require
if msg.sender is a contract, the raw full balance transfer in TeamAvoidBurning can re-enter transfer before state settles

normalization_plan.reason: sender is only a symbolic alias for the account whose _balances and _sellLock entries are read and written inside _taxedTransfer
recipient is only a symbolic alias for the account credited in _taxedTransfer
amount is the value consumed by the fee, limit and balance arithmetic of _taxedTransfer
isBuy only selects the buy branch (tax, whale limits) inside _taxedTransfer
isSell only selects the sell branch (lock, blacklist, dump protection) inside _taxedTransfer
tknAddress is only used to build the external token handle drained by TeamRescueTokens
sellLockSeconds is only validated against MaxSellLockTime and stored by TeamSetSellLockTime
tax is a short lived scalar selecting the applied tax inside _taxedTransfer
contractToken is the intermediate fee result of _taxedTransfer credited to the contract
taxedAmount is the intermediate net amount credited to the recipient inside _taxedTransfer
senderBalance is a cached balance read of sender used by the require inside _taxedTransfer
